headline: Sensex Rallies 1,225 Points to Hit Record Highs as Nifty Surpasses 23,800 Mark

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Highest FPI buying recorded in a year
Strong FII inflows into Indian markets
Positive global cues from DJIA, S&P, and NASDAQ
whatHappening: Sensex surged 1,225 points to hit a record intraday high
Nifty50 closed at 23,810, gaining for the fourth consecutive session
NSE-listed firms added approximately ₹5 lakh crore to their market capitalization
The Sensex has jumped over 3,400 points across the last four trading sessions
summary: Indian equity markets witnessed a massive rally with the Sensex jumping 1,225 points and Nifty closing at a record 23,810. The surge was driven by the highest FPI buying in a year and easing macro pressures, marking the fourth straight day of gains. Investors added ₹5 lakh crore in wealth as indices hit new intraday highs amid strong global cues.
